application_type_full: Householder planning & demolition in a conservation area
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - Commencement of development (Full Permission) - The development to which this permission relates shall be commenced not later than the expiration of 3 years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - Approved Plans - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans: 2505-014; 021; 017; 016; 020; 019; 018; 024; 025; 015; 023; 022; 001; Arboricultural Report; Design Statement.

Condition : 3 - Materials as Specified - The facing materials to be used for the development hereby permitted shall be those specified in the application form unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - No Use of Flat Roof  - Access to the flat roof of the development hereby permitted shall be for maintenance or emergency purposes only, and the flat roof shall not be used as a roof garden, terrace, patio or similar amenity area.

Condition : 5 - Tree Protection: The details and measures for the protection of the existing trees as specified 
in the hereby approved document `BS 5837:2012 Tree Survey, Arboricultural Impact 
Assessment, Arboricultural Method Statement and Tree Protection Plan� dated �August 2025' 
shall be fully complied with. The methods for the protection of the existing trees shall fully 
accord with all of the measures specified in the report and shall be installed prior to the 
commencement of any site works and shall remain in place until the conclusion of all site 
works. 

Reason: To protect and safeguard the existing trees in accordance with the following 
Development Plan policies for Merton: policy G7 of the London Plan 2021,policies 015.1, 
015.2 and 015.4 of the Local Plan 2024.

Condition : 6 - Site Supervision (Trees) - The details of the approved document 'BS 5837:2012 Tree Survey, 
Arboricultural Impact Assessment, Arboricultural Method Statement and Tree Protection Plan' 
shall include the retention of an arboricultural expert to monitor and report to the Local 
Planning Authority not less than monthly the status of all tree works and tree protection 
measures throughout the course of the demolition and site works. A final Certificate of 
Completion shall be submitted to and agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority at the 
conclusion of all site works and prior to the first occupation of the development hereby 
approved. The works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved Arboricultural 
Method Statement and Tree Protection Plan.

Reason: To protect and safeguard the existing trees in accordance with the following 
Development Plan policies for Merton: policy G7 of the London Plan 2021,policies 015.1, 
015.2 and 015.4 of the Local Plan 2024

Condition : 7 - INFORMATIVE - Bricks

The Council as local planning authority, recognizes the importance of achieving high standards of site practice and workmanship in the course of construction and acknowledges that this will have significant influence upon the quality of the finished brickwork.

The applicant is therefore encouraged to follow the advice set out in the Brick Development Association publication: Good site practice and workmanship (December 2015)  https://www.brick.org.uk/admin/resources/g-good-site-practice-workmanship.pdf when implementing the development hereby approved.

Condition : 8 - INFORMATIVE
Building Regulations 
Please note that this is a planning permission only and you may also require approval under the Building Regulations. If you are in any doubt about this you can get further information via https://www.merton.gov.uk/planning-and-buildings/building-control  or by emailing building.control@merton.gov.uk.

Condition : 9 - INFORMATIVE
Note to Applicant -Approved Schemes
In accordance with paragraph 38 of the National Planning Policy Framework, London Borough of Merton (LBM) takes a positive and proactive approach to the delivery of sustainable development, by:
1. Providing a formal pre-application advice service, details to be found on Planning pre-application advice service on LBM's website
2. Providing written policies and guidance, which is available to view on LBM's website.
3. Where appropriate, negotiating amendments to secure a positive decision.
4. Determining applications in a timely manner including providing a fast track service, details to be found on Get a quicker planning decision on LBM's website.

In this instance:
i) The application was acceptable as submitted, and approved [without delay/ with an agreed determination date].
